mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Toxic Shot</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is poisoned, receiving damage each second.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Teemo's Attacks apply poison %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing an additional <magicDamage>@ImpactCalculatedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> plus <magicDamage>@TotalDotDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @PoisonDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This poison deals @MonsterMod*100@% damage to jungle monsters.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Toxic Attack</titleLeft><mainText>Teemo's attacks poison the target, causing them to take damage over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Toxic Shot</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is poisoned, receiving damage each second.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Element of Surprise</titleLeft><mainText>Teemo has the element of surprise, increasing his Attack Speed temporarily.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Guerrilla Warfare</titleLeft><mainText>Teemo is <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font> and can only be revealed by nearby enemy Turrets.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Guerrilla WarfareIf Teemo stands still for 1.5 seconds without being damaged, he becomes Invisible. While in a brush he can trigger and maintain Invisibility while moving.

Upon breaking Guerrilla Warfare by attacking or moving (out of brush), Teemo gains @f1@% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

Stealth - Invisible: Teemo can only be revealed by nearby enemy Turrets or True Sight.

mLocKeys.keySummary: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
If Teemo stands still for @StealthCooldownDuration@ seconds without being damaged, he becomes Invisible until he moves. While in a brush, he can maintain Invisibility while moving.

Upon exiting this Invisibility, Teemo gains @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Teemo fires a dart, <status>Blinding</status> the target for @BlindDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@CalculatedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Minions and jungle monsters are <status>Blinded</status> for @MinionMonsterDurationMod*100@% longer.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Noxious Trap</titleLeft><mainText>This trap will detonate if an enemy steps on it, poisoning nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by @SlowAmount@% and deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @DebuffDuration@ seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration.

Traps last @MushroomDuration@ minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has @MaxAmmo@ charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Noxious Trap</titleLeft><mainText>This unit was poisoned by a mushroom and is taking damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Noxious Trap</titleLeft><mainText>This trap will detonate if an enemy steps on it, poisoning nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Move Quick</titleLeft><mainText>Teemo scampers around, gaining extreme Move Speed for a short time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Teemo gains @PassiveMoveSpeedBonus*100@% Move Speed while he hasn't been damaged by a champion or turret in the last @PassiveCooldownOnDamageTaken@ seconds.

Active: Teemo sprints, gaining @ActiveMoveSpeedBonus*100@% Move Speed that is not lost when struck for @ActiveMoveSpeedBuffDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Move Quick</titleLeft><mainText>Teemo moves very quickly until he takes damage from a turret or champion.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Move Quick Cooldown</titleLeft><mainText>Teemo has taken damage and is not moving quickly.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
